object_description: compact volume with a small footprint around a top-lit central staircase
geometry_property: central staircase as a spatial element
design_condition: the building keeps a small footprint in its urban setting, organised stringently around a central top-lit staircase that brings daylight far down into the volume

positive: The authors took up the criticism of the architectural expression and internal organisation, which is welcomed
The central staircase was rethought and developed into a spatially strong element
The zenithal skylight and the staggered flights of stairs let daylight reach far down
The facade design breaks away from its 1970s role models without abandoning the basic concept
The verticality is broken up and the choice of materials somewhat purified
The interior has been spatially enriched by the revision
The design impresses with its urban setting and its clever and stringent organisation
negative: The connection to the outside space on the floors remains unresolved
The proposed transparency of the classrooms to the stairwell is not feasible from a school perspective
The appearance of this space for an elementary school is viewed critically
The monumentality of the expression remains
The newly introduced division into plinth and main facade is not convincing
The design of the surroundings does not exploit the potential of the small footprint
Questions remain as to how the surroundings should be used
The handling of scale and architectural expression evokes grammar or vocational schools
It ultimately does not seem appropriate for an elementary school
